name: Ama Ane Princess Irina to Nangoku Oukyuu Kozukuri ~Watashi no Shikyuu de Zenbu Uketomete Ageru♪ Anata no Aka-chan ga Hoshii no~
original_name: あまあねプリンセス・イリーナと南国王宮子作り～私の子宮で全部受け止めてあげる♪貴方の赤ちゃんが欲しいの～
source:
The main character is an ordinary student.
One day, he is kidnapped by someone and when he wakes up, he finds himself surrounded by 3 beautiful women in a luxury palace.
They turn out to be princesses in a small tropical country and ask for the childmaking to be regarded as the official couple.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE053214.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名普通學生。
有一天，他被人綁架，醒來後發現自己在一座豪華宮殿裡，被三位美女包圍。
原來，她們是某個熱帶小國的公主。為了獲得正式夫妻的名分，她們要求他跟自己生孩子。

[出自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE053214.html]英文DLSite[/url]]
